title: Tenpai Hand Scoring Practice
description: Game-style riichi mahjong scoring practice: read the waits of a tenpai hand, then score each wait by tsumo and by ron.
exitToast: You left Tenpai Hand Scoring Practice

machi.title: 1. Pick the waits
machi.caption: You see a tenpai hand with the round wind, your seat wind and the dora. Select every winning tile and answer; the frame color of each tile shows whether it was right.

cells.title: 2. Score each wait
cells.caption: Press a cell in the wait × tsumo/ron grid to open the answer fields and enter {fields, select, hanFu {the han, the fu and the score} other {the score}}. Cells with the same score can be joined into one with Same answer. For a wait that has no yaku and cannot win by ron, press No yaku.

result.title: 3. Review
result.caption: You see how you did on the waits, then the correct score for each wait on the Tsumo and Ron tabs. Switch tabs to check your answer and the breakdown (yaku and fu) for each winning hand.

board.title: Tenpai hand
board.description: A tenpai hand of 13 tiles. The round wind, your seat wind and the dora also affect the score.

picker.title: Pick the waits
picker.description: Press every winning tile to select it. There is more than one.

machiSubmit.title: Answer the waits
machiSubmit.description: After you answer, the frame color of each tile shows whether it was right. Then you move on to scoring.

cells.title: Wait × tsumo/ron cells
cells.description: Press a cell to open the answer fields below. Different waits often give the same score, so you can join cells in the same column (tsumo or ron) with Same answer and fill them in once.

answerForm.title: Answer fields
answerForm.description: Enter {fields, select, hanFu {the han, the fu and the score} other {the score}} for the selected cells. Once you apply it, the next unanswered cell in the same column is selected (when a column is full, the top of the other column is next). For a wait that has no yaku and cannot win by ron, select its ron cell and press No yaku to apply it right away.

cellsSubmit.title: Answer
cellsSubmit.description: Becomes available once every cell is filled and none is still being answered. All cells are checked together.

notes.mentsuOnly: Note: only standard hands (four sets and a pair) are asked; no chiitoitsu or kokushi musou.
notes.multiWait: Note: only tenpai hands with two or more winning tiles are asked.

machi.incorrect: Incorrect. Check the correct waits, then go on to scoring.

cells.prompt: Score each wait by tsumo and by ron
cells.selecting: Apply your answer to the selected cells or clear the selection to answer.

result.noYakuDetail: This wait has no yaku, so it cannot win by ron.
